messages:
Sam: Heads-up: building a compact preflight runcard for customers who see sporadic streaming disconnects or sudden token bursts during onboarding. Needs to be pasteable into emails.
Tara: Great. Keep it to 1 page, very action-oriented. 3 checks, 2 quick fixes, 1 escalation path.
Diego: Draft checks: 1) SDK version (>=1.6.0) 2) Network check: wifi vs cellular, MTU issues, carrier NAT 3) Client concurrency and batch_window settings.
Ivy: Add a short "if demo/live" box: fallback to non-stream, shorten prompt, attach request_id. Say we can enable warm-pool prefill on request.
Sam: Include tiny examples in Go and curl so it's useful for more engineering-savvy contacts. Also add a telemetry trio: avg tokens/session, 95p latency, disconnects per 10k.
Tara: Suggested healthy thresholds to show customers: tokens/session < 750; 95p latency < 600ms; disconnects < 5 per 10k. Phrase: "If any metric is worse, try the quick fixes below."
Diego: Go snippet (progressive batching + stream guard):
```go
// progressive batching with stream fallback
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN"))
resp, err := client.Stream(&redwood.StreamOpts{
  Model: "redwood-mini",
  BatchWindowMs: 25,
  MaxConcurrentSessions: 3,
  TokenSurgeGuard: &redwood.SurgeGuard{Threshold: 1800, Action: "throttle"},
})
if err != nil {
  // fallback to non-stream with short max tokens
  resp, _ = client.Generate(&redwood.GenOpts{Model: "redwood-mini", Stream: false, MaxTokens: 120})
}
```
Ivy: curl fallback for non-engineer contacts: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","stream":false,"max_tokens":120,"prompt":"<trimmed>"}'
```
Sam: Quick fixes box (one-line actions):
- Upgrade SDK to latest stable.
- If on mobile: switch to wifi and re-run a single request.
- Set stream=false for retries and reduce max_tokens to 120.
- If you need streaming: lower batch_window_ms to 15-40ms and enable token_surge_guard action=throttle.
Tara: What we need from the customer (exact asks): request_id(s), last 30s SDK logs (verbose), network type, sample prompt, and trace-id from response headers.
Diego: Escalation rules we propose:
- 2+ verified stream disconnects within 36h -> schedule 30m troubleshooting call + priority warm-pool prefill.
- If usage drops >25% after incidents -> attach renewal_soft_signal tag and propose enablement session.
Ivy: Also add a quick how-to for capturing logs: enable SDK DEBUG, reproduce one request, paste logs and subject with request_id to support@redwood.ai.
CS Bot: Auto-draft saved to https://internal.redwood/cs/cards/preflight-stream-2812345678. Reminder: review at 4:15pm PT.
Sam: I'll assemble the single-page PDF and a short email blurb: "We can help — try these three quick checks now, and if the issue persists well jump on a 30-minute troubleshooting session and collect a debug bundle."
Tara: Tone looks good. Add a one-line privacy note about logs (we only use them for debugging, purge on request).
Diego: I'll add a tiny note about TLS renegotiation and MTU as a possible carrier cause for mobile weirdness.
Ivy: Ready to send after a quick compliance pass. Tag me if you want me on the call.
CS Bot: Review reminder posted in calendar and DMed owners. :bell:
